projects.title: Recent work
projects.intro: Products and apps built end to end: design, development and launch.

items.title: Repwise
items.description: Management software for personal trainers and small clubs: clients, sessions, memberships and invoices in one place. The waitlist runs itself and clients book from their phone.
features: One-to-one or group sessions with an automatic waitlist
Session packs or monthly plans, with alerts before they run out
Invoices with automatic numbering and PDF download
A client portal to book and cancel from a phone
items.alt: Repwise image with the line “Fill every class. Chase no one.” and the app’s management dashboard

items.title: Swish & Legacy
items.description: A free basketball career simulator you play in the browser, with nothing to download. You don’t play the games: you make the career decisions and the seasons are simulated from your ratings, your team and chance.
features: Create your player at 14: position, nationality, playing style and archetype
US high school and college, the NBA, the EuroLeague and leagues in Europe, Asia, Australia and South America
The draft, MVPs and championships, with a season-by-season record
A Hall of Fame, 29 achievements and a daily challenge
items.alt: Swish & Legacy image with the title “Free Basketball Career Simulator” and screens of the game’s career and achievements

items.title: CamEscola
items.description: A management platform for an athletics sports school. Families see their children’s personal bests, check upcoming competitions and sign up for them. It includes user management and statistics.
items.alt: CamEscola image with the line “Segueix cada marca. Celebra cada cursa.” and the competition calendar from the parents’ area

items.title: Sergi Garcia Training
items.description: An app for coaches that organises training with their clients in a shared calendar. Every workout gets its own feedback, so the coach knows how each session went.
items.alt: Sergi Garcia Training image with the coach’s motto, the workout feedback form and the calendar

items.title: Tresdegé
items.description: A portfolio for a graphic design studio in Barcelona, with its work and services in a fast website. The work comes first and the contact details are always within reach.
items.alt: Tresdegé image, a graphic design studio, with its name set large on a blue background

interlude.text: You work directly with me, with no middlemen and no templates.

about.lead: I help people and businesses get a website that is clear, tidy and easy to use.
paragraphs: I focus on fixing confusing or careless websites, combining design, development and close attention to detail.
I mostly work with React, Firebase and WordPress, and I pick the tool for what each project needs, not the other way round.
